ranges: Zero-based [start,stop); CSV step identifies a controlled action, not wallclock time. Physical control_dt=.05s from unchanged LIBERO configuration.

methods.action_xyz_norm: Euclidean norm of normalized xyz action; installed OSC config maps each component by .05m, which is a target increment, not actual travel.
methods.eef_step: Primary: norm(state_xyz[i+1]-state_xyz[i]), consecutive fresh pre-action observations. The final action has no next fresh pre-observation and is excluded. Cached env.step post-minus-pre is retained in explicitly named fields; it can understate a full physical control step.
methods.lift_evidence: bowl height > initial observed height+.02m for at least10 consecutive frames. Closing command alone is not evidence of a secure grasp.
methods.possible_comotion: 20-step window: bowl elevated throughout, close command throughout, relative EEF-bowl XYZ range norm<.01m and bowl net move>.005m. This is local kinematic coupling, not long-duration stable grasp certification.
methods.candidate_large_command_low_motion: xyz norm>=.15 and primary fresh-next-pre EEF step<.0002m. Isolated frames do not prove contact obstruction.
methods.overfitting_boundary: These four rollouts alone do not measure train-vs-heldout error or establish overfitting.
